initialExam.title: SSC MTS 2026
initialExam.description: Multi Tasking Staff exam for Group C non-technical posts in various central government departments. Notification expected June 2026.
initialExam.syllabus: Session-I: Numerical & Mathematical Ability (20Q), Reasoning & Problem Solving (20Q). Session-II: General Awareness (25Q), English Language & Comprehension (25Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Session-I: 40 questions, 120 marks, 45 min (no negative marking). Session-II: 50 questions, 75 marks, 45 min (0.25 negative marking).
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT Session-I → CBT Session-II → Document Verification
initialExam.jobRole: Peon, Daftary, Jamadar, Junior Gestetner Operator, Chowkidar, Safaiwala in government offices
initialExam.careerGrowth: MTS → LDC → UDC through departmental exams and promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill application 4. Upload photo/signature 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical Benefits, Pension, Leave benefits

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
